name: io.github.GabiUp2/taskchampion-mcp
description: MCP server for Taskwarrior 3.x, TaskChampion, and Timewarrior — read, create, modify, and manage tasks from any LLM assistant.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks matching optional Taskwarrior filter expressions

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full details for a single task by UUID

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by keyword or regex pattern

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: List all project names in the task database

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: List all tags in the task database

tools.name: get_schema_info
tools.description: Return the loaded schema definition for LLM context

tools.name: annotate_task
tools.description: Add an annotation to a task by UUID

tools.name: modify_task
tools.description: Modify fields on an existing task by UUID

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task with schema validation

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done by UUID

tools.name: timew_status
tools.description: Check if Timewarrior is currently tracking time

tools.name: timew_start
tools.description: Start tracking time with optional tags
